top_story_title: Cisco assessing product exposure to five critical nginx vulnerabilities, including remote code execution
top_story_summary: On November 18, 2026 nginx released fixes for multiple critical vulnerabilities that can lead to remote code execution. The advisory states the flaws affect nginx releases 1.9.5 through 1.31.8 and are fixed in 1.31.9 (mainline) and 1.30.7 (stable). Five CVEs are named: CVE-2026-113425 (ngx_mail_proxy_module), CVE-2026-121810 (ngx_http_v3_module), CVE-2026-123007 and CVE-2026-123633 (ngx_http_v2_module), and CVE-2026-123634 (the resolver).
top_actions: Subscribe to or re-check cisco-sa-nginx-nov-2026 daily until Cisco publishes the affected-product list and fixed releases; the advisory is explicitly marked as pending update.
In the meantime, confirm from your asset inventory which Cisco appliances expose an HTTPS management interface or an nginx-fronted proxy/data-plane listener, and to which networks.
Remove appliance management access (HTTPS/SSH/API) from internet-facing and untrusted interfaces; restrict it to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network.
Where you run nginx or nginx-derived front ends on other network appliances or your own reverse proxies, check those against the stated upstream fixed releases 1.31.9 (mainline) and 1.30.7 (stable).
Do not plan a Cisco upgrade against an assumed version - no fixed Cisco release is stated; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release before opening a change window.
executive_summary: One network-device item in this 24h window: Cisco PSIRT on five critical nginx vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-113425, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-123634), upstream fixed in nginx 1.31.9 and 1.30.7.
Cisco has not yet named the affected products or any fixed Cisco release, so today's work is inventory and management-plane exposure reduction, not patching.
No CISA KEV listings and no reported exploitation in this window.
One collected item dropped: an AI inference-provider data-theft report matched the keyword filter on the name 'OpenRouter' and concerns no network device.
key_actions: **Cisco** — Track cisco-sa-nginx-nov-2026 for the affected-product list and fixed releases; it is published as a pending advisory and carries no Cisco version information yet.

**Cisco** — Build the candidate list from your own inventory: Cisco appliances with an HTTPS/web management UI or an nginx-fronted proxy listener, recorded with model and running version, ready to match against Cisco's list when it lands.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in nginx Affecting Cisco Products: November 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco is assessing which of its products bundle nginx after five critical nginx flaws, including remote code execution, were fixed upstream in 1.31.9 and 1.30.7.
